subject: Escalation: FinSolve pilot—request for exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause
messages:
From: Simon Cho <simon.cho@finsolve.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sales_ops@finsolve.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot terms — request: temporary exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. We’re preparing the pilot PO but we have three commercial asks from our procurement/legal side that are gating sign-off:

1) A 90-day exclusivity window for the pilot product category (FinSolve will not engage other inference vendors for the same pilot scope for 90 days).
2) A Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) pricing clause for the pilot term — they want parity with any lower price you offer another customer in the same segment for 12 months.
3) A benchmark clause: if your model underperforms the agreed accuracy/latency targets on our evaluation set, we can either (a) terminate with pro-rated refund or (b) switch to a price credit.

I’ve attached a clean term sheet and a redline from our legal team for reference. Happy to discuss — we’re targeting a PO by next week if we can resolve these items.

Best,
Simon
Head of Product Partnerships
FinSolve
Attachment: FinSolve_TermSheet_redline.docx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot terms — request: temporary exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause

Forwarding FinSolve ask — high risk commercial language (MFN + exclusivity + refund/credit benchmark).

Key points:
- Deal size: $180k pilot + potential $1.2M expansion in 12 months (deal in HubSpot: DL-2026-457).
- Request affects pricing levers and competitive restrictions.
- Legal redline attached; procurement wants to move quickly.

Laura — can Legal push back on scope/duration of exclusivity and narrow MFN definition (we prefer only matching published public commercial offers, not private deals)?
Marissa/Rishi — if we accept anything resembling MFN/exclusivity, what approvals do you want? Estimated margin impact if we concede a 12-month MFN on pilot pricing: ~10-15% headroom loss (see attached pricing model).

Thanks — Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot terms — request: temporary exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause

Jonas — quick Legal assessment:
- Exclusivity: we can consider a narrowly scoped, non-renewing pilot exclusivity limited to the exact product SKU and a 30-day window post-pilot. 90 days as written is broader than we accept.
- MFN: flat MFN against private side deals is a blocker. Counter: MFN should be limited to public list/published pricing or to customers of the same size band with the same committed volumes. Also cap duration to 6 months.
- Benchmark clause: Acceptable if metrics and evaluation dataset are mutually agreed and remediation is limited to service credits (no automatic termination or refunds except for gross negligence).

I’ve marked up the attached redline with those positions. If Sales wants to concede more, we need exec signoff.

— Laura
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
Attachment: FinSolve_TermSheet_Legal_comments.docx

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot terms — request: temporary exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause

Thanks Laura — echoing caution. Commercial notes:
- FinSolve is strategic for our roadmap (strong reference potential), but MFN + 90d exclusivity at pilot scale materially constrains GTM flexibility.
- If Sales wants to accelerate close we should consider a compromise: 45-day exclusivity (pilot category only), MFN limited to published spacing and capped at 6 months, and benchmark remediation = service credits up to 25% of pilot fees.
- To sign off on any MFN/exclusivity beyond those caps I need documented P&L impact and approval from Marissa + COO/CEO signoff.

Marissa: can you quantify upside if we provide these concessions? If the expansion probability is >60% within 12 months, we could make a targeted concession (with a written playbook for cross-reference pricing).

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot terms — request: temporary exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause

Agree with Legal and Rishi. Practical sales position to move this:
- Offer 45-day, SKU-limited exclusivity for pilot only.
- MFN: restrict to published price tiers; add clause requiring FinSolve to notify us if they get a better public price within 6 months (we will not accept secret private parity).
- Benchmark: accept evaluation with jointly agreed dataset. Remedies limited to service credit (up to 25%).

I’m prepared to sign off on this counter if Jonas confirms FinSolve will accept those points and if Finance signs off on the credit cap. This will be marked as an exceptional concession — we should document the deal playbook and require legal to include non-assignability language.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: simon.cho@finsolve.com, anna.kim@finsolve.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot terms — request: temporary exclusivity + MFN + benchmark clause

Simon / Anna — thanks for the quick turn. We spoke internally and can accept a limited set of concessions to keep the pilot moving:

1) Exclusivity — we will agree to a 45-day exclusivity window tied strictly to the pilot SKU and scope. Non-renewing and non-assignable.

2) MFN — we will accept MFN limited to published pricing tiers and public offers only, capped at 6 months from pilot start. Private/side deals are excluded. If FinSolve receives a public lower price in that window you agree to notify Redwood within 14 days.

3) Benchmark remediation — we will use the jointly defined test set; remediation is limited to service credits up to 25% of pilot fees. No automatic termination or cash refund absent gross negligence.

Please confirm acceptance and we’ll circulate the updated term sheet (attached) and route to procurement. Appreciate the urgency — if you confirm today we can issue the PO and start onboarding next week.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: FinSolve_Redwood_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf
